utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I can use whatever help you’ve got, even if it’s just a little.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I can swing by and help sort donations or carry a few things. Just point me in the right direction and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Oren. If you could come by tomorrow afternoon, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — could you bring any spare tools and some extension cords? And just a reminder, the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll bring spare tools and extension cords on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep—please get the gate repair lined up first, and if you can, keep the leak and steps light next on the list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it — I’ll line up the gate repair first, then keep the leak and steps next on the list. I’ll send out the reminder for Saturday at 9 at the community lot, too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — thanks. Keep me posted if the gate timing changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can line up the gate repair now and bring a wrench and screwdriver in case we need them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Gus — that’ll help a lot. I’ll check our supplies and make a quick list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I still need the full plan for the repair drive—what time and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s this Sunday at the community center—let’s start with the most urgent repairs first and sort the rest as we go.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday at the community center sounds good, but what time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still waiting on the final word, but it sounds like old tools and broken lamps are being dropped off by the community hall. If I hear anything new, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — I’m a bit worried about the logistics, so please let me know as soon as the location or drop-off details are final.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep an ear out for the final location and drop-off details, and I’ll pass them along as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still spreading the word and telling folks to meet at the community center parking lot sign-in table. If you’d like, I can nudge a few more neighbors to come by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — that’s perfect. I’ll stay at the community center parking lot sign-in table and keep the drop-off there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll keep nudging neighbors and point them straight to the community center parking lot sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the repair drive is this Saturday at 9 at the community center, and we’re collecting donations and volunteers. I can help spread the word if you want—I might need the details one more time, though.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — Saturday at 9 at the community center, with donations and volunteers. Before I bring anything, I’ll ask first if they still need tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’d be great — I think tools or spare parts would probably help most, but I might need the list again. If you check first, we won’t end up with extras no one needs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard all the details yet—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help fill in the details—do you know the start time and drop-off spot yet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet—what time and where should people drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, that’d be great — I’m still lining up what we need, and I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive to a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’m a bit late, but I can help spread the word too. Just let me know what kind of repair help you still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Dane — I’ll let you know what’s still needed, and I’ll keep talking it up with the neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules—just let folks know we’re collecting donations and volunteers for the repair drive this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center and ask folks to bring donations or volunteer if they can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks, Jules — I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mina — just help sort the donations when they start coming in. I’m still waiting on the latest update, so I’ll let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Of course — I’ll be ready to sort the donations when they come in. Just let me know when you hear the update.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’m keeping an ear out for the latest update, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear donations are starting to come in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — we’re collecting donations and volunteers for the repair drive this Saturday at the community center. If you can, please spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the start time and exactly where people should drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t have the exact start time on hand yet, but it’s at the community center—I'll confirm the details and let you know where to drop everything off.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense—can you send me the list when you have it? I’d like to help once I know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes — I’m putting the list together now, and I’ll send it as soon as I have it. The drop-off spot is now the community center on Sunday, so that should keep things simpler.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, that helps. I’ll look out for the list and can help once it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I can help gather spare tools, screws, and tape for the repair drive. Just let me know the time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks, Sam. I’ll send the time and drop-off spot once I’ve got it pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Bo — just let me know when you’ve got the details pinned down, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still a bit out of the loop—has the repair drive started yet, or are we still waiting on donations to come in?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still waiting on donations to come in, but I can check what supplies we’ve got and make a quick list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, great—thanks, Cleo. Just let me know what’s needed, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I can help spread the word, but I still need the time and meeting spot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — sorry, I’m a bit scattered today. I don’t have the time and meeting spot handy, but I can help track it down or check with Mina if you want.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Oren — that’d help a lot. Please check with Mina, and once we have the time and meeting spot I’ll spread it around right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll drop everything at your porch on Maple Street and label anything fragile. Let me know if you want me to bring anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — that sounds perfect. I’ll be there Saturday at 9 and can help sort things around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Saturday at 9 works for me — I’ll leave it on your Maple Street porch. If you think of anything else for the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah, sorry I’m late — what do you still need for the repair drive? I can help where I’m able.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Dane — I think we still need donations and a few volunteers for Saturday at 9 at the community center. If you can help spread the word, that’d be great; I may be a bit fuzzy on the details, though.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I can help spread the word and try to bring a couple more neighbors by Saturday at 9. Just let me know if there’s a specific donation list I should share.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll stop by later and ask what they still need, then send anyone I see over to the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great, Uli — I’ll keep spreading the word too, and we can send folks to the sign-in table if they need help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Great, thanks — I’ll do that later and keep an eye out for anyone who needs directions.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m planning to bring the wrench and screwdriver by the community hall. If the gate still needs fixing, I can take a look at that too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great — I’m out running errands later, so I’ll ask around and see if they still need any tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Ira — thanks. If you hear they need anything specific, just let me know and I’ll bring it by the hall.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday at 9, and we can meet at my place first before heading over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Leo — meeting at your place first works. I’ll see you both Saturday at 9, and Faye, I’ll keep the school schedule in mind.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — see you Saturday at 9 at my place.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I still need the full plan for the repair drive—what time and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard it’s out by the community hall, and folks are bringing old tools and broken lamps. I don’t have the exact time yet, but I can ask around for the full details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. Please let me know the exact time when you find it so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Just a quick update—the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now. If you’re dropping anything off, I’m happy to help make sure it gets there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Rosa. Is it already collecting donations, or are you still setting things up?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re still setting up, but you can definitely bring donations on Sunday at the community center. If you want, I can also help hold onto anything until then.
